upstream.license: MIT for benchmark code; component datasets retain their own licenses

benchmark.generation: preserve each pinned config's max length, chat-template, shots, stop, and sample count
benchmark.scoring: official per-category post-processing and raw plus .score outputs
benchmark.staging: run one length at a time and retain category-level results

data.reason: the research filesystem has less than 8GB free
data.qualification_rule: use a separate capacity-planned volume, preserve dataset licenses, and record every extracted file hash

model_adapter.mode: native Hugging Face trust_remote_code adapter with attn_implementation=eager and compilation disabled for qualification
model_adapter.reason: the adapter source is compatible in principle, but its device_map path requires Accelerate and the first isolated smoke was stopped after an environment resolver attempted a duplicate CUDA stack
model_adapter.required_next: add a locked external-evaluation environment and run local-export load, tokenize, generate, and raw-output smoke without changing HELMET prompts or scoring

release_use: required independent suite after external storage and model-adapter qualification
